name: smwmusic-super-formation-soccer-ii-win
title: Super Formation Soccer II - Win
description:
The victory theme from Super Formation Soccer 2.

Was originally made to be a global song, but since it takes up a lot of ARAM space (+ needing to include @14 as a global sample), I'd not recommend using it as such, unless you really want to.

Be aware that both of the sound effect channels house the percussion. Use in normal levels is not recommended.
